instruction: Recursively copy every .txt file from the current directory and its subdirectories to './backup_txt', preserving the folder hierarchy.

metadata.explanation: Task variation that requires copying all *.txt files to a backup_txt directory while preserving directory structure. The setup creates 5 text files in different locations: docs/guides/readme.txt, docs/guides/tutorial.txt, logs/system/error.txt, logs/system/debug.txt, and config/settings.txt. The evaluator verifies all text files are copied to ./backup_txt with correct directory structure.
